caption: The drawing contains three stylized birds positioned vertically on a beige, lightly textured background. The top bird is yellowish-brown with green, red, and white patterns on its wings and body, and it has red legs and feet, a white neck ring, and a red beak; its eyes are round with a white outline. The middle bird is mostly golden yellow with brownish wings patterned with green scales and a large red heart motif near the body, red legs and feet, a green pointed beak, and a red face area with a white ring around the eye. The bottom bird has a mostly white body with red and green zigzag bands and an intricate brown and green wing pattern with a green tail featuring parallel black lines; it has a green head, white eye with a red ring, a brown beak, red throat, and dark green legs and feet. All three birds are outlined in dark green or black, and each has distinct geometric and organic decorative patterns on their feathers, wings, and tails.
title: Drawing for Plate 10: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
